audit.note: the three value-state links toast round-trip-free; nothing comes back to the backend

deviations.what: the formattedValueStateText aggregation of sap.m.ComboBox is @since 1.78 - newer than the 1.71 floor but kept for the 1:1 port, since two of the six ComboBoxes exist to show exactly that (a value-state message carrying one link, and one carrying two). The app needs a UI5 release >= 1.78; below it the lowercase tag resolves as a control class and the 404 takes the whole view down, which is why this is an error rather than a warning.

every one of the six items bindings is declared `suspended: true` and resumed by handleLoadItems on the first open - a lazy-loading trick for a list the model already holds. abap2UI5 sends the rows with the view, so there is nothing to suspend and nothing to resume: the port binds the 70 countries outright and the loadItems wire is dropped. What the user sees is the same list.

handleValueStateLinkPress toasts the constant 'Link in value state pressed', so all three links are wired round-trip-free as follow_up_action( control_global, MESSAGE_TOAST show ) (app 005/032 idiom). Their href="" is carried as the sample writes it.

the bindings carry a sorter on text; a thin frontend sorts the data it sends, so the 70 rows of countriesExtendedCollection.json are seeded verbatim in the mock's order and SORTed by text in model_init - never through SORT BY (field), which the transpiled backend drops (the 2026-08-22 e2e finding).

the two ComboBoxes that carry a formattedValueStateText ALSO carry the plain valueStateText in the sample (the long 'Warning message. Extra long text ...' string) - UI5 shows the formatted one and ignores the plain one. Both are kept, since both are what the sample writes; app 032 carries the same pair for sap.m.Input.
